title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA/Okta) Issues
diagnostic_questions: Which MFA method are you using? (Okta Verify push, SMS, authenticator code)
Did you recently get a new phone?
Is the Okta Verify app installed on your phone?
Are you able to receive text messages on your registered phone?

diagnostic_tools.purpose: Verify Okta SSO service is operational

resolution_steps.action: First, check if the Okta Verify app is up to date. Go to your phone's app store and check for updates to Okta Verify.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Is the Okta Verify app updated to the latest version?

resolution_steps.action: Try using an alternative MFA method. On the Okta login page, click 'Verify with something else' and select SMS or Email verification instead of push notification.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Were you able to log in using an alternative MFA method?

resolution_steps.action: If push notifications aren't working, make sure your phone has internet connectivity and that notifications are enabled for the Okta Verify app. Go to Settings → Notifications → Okta Verify → Enable notifications.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Are notifications now enabled for Okta Verify?

resolution_steps.action: If you got a new phone and need to re-enroll in MFA, this requires an identity verification and MFA reset. This is a security-sensitive action that our team will assist with.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: N/A — proceeding to assisted MFA reset

escalation_criteria: If user needs MFA re-enrollment (new phone) or if Okta service is degraded
